evals.prompt: Log in as a test user with the 'Customer Service' role and verify the Service Request form shows the correct fields and that the Submit button is visible and enabled for that role.
evals.expected_output: A browser session that logs in as the test role, navigates to the form, captures a screenshot, and checks console errors — with evidence attached
expectations: A dedicated test user (not Administrator) with the Customer Service role is used for the session
The agent navigates to the correct Desk route for the Service Request DocType
A screenshot of the form is captured as evidence, showing the field layout and the Submit button state
The browser console is checked for errors after the form loads
The result states clearly whether the Submit button is visible and enabled for the test role

evals.prompt: I deployed a portal page update for the customer complaints portal. Capture before/after screenshots to confirm the change rendered correctly for a guest user, and check that no API calls are failing in the network tab.
evals.expected_output: Before and after screenshots of the portal page with guest credentials, plus a network tab check showing no failing frappe.call or REST calls
expectations: The portal is accessed without a Desk session — either as a guest or a portal-only user, not as Administrator
Both a before and after screenshot are captured, or the agent explains why a before screenshot is unavailable
The network tab or console output is inspected for failing API calls after the page loads
Any failing network request is identified by URL and status code, not dismissed as 'looks fine'
